user.title: Masterbuilt Gravity
user.description: Choose your grill's brand and sign in with the account you use in its mobile app. The credentials are stored locally in Home Assistant and sent only to that manufacturer's own cloud.

data_description.brand: Masterbuilt Gravity Series and Kamado Joe Konnected Joe grills run on the same cloud backend. Pick the app your grill is paired in.

device.title: Choose your grills
device.description: Your account has more than one paired grill. Pick the ones to add to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud rejected the saved password for {email}. Enter it again to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the grill's cloud.
error.no_devices: That account signed in, but has no paired grills. Pair the grill in the manufacturer's app first.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the grill's cloud.
data_description.stale_after: How long the grill can go without reporting before the Stale data sensor turns on. The grill can keep cooking while its WiFi drops out, so this is more trustworthy than the Power sensor.
data_description.track_history: Records a downsampled series for the current cook, for charting. Turn off if you only chart from Recorder history.

get_cook_history.name: Get cook history
get_cook_history.description: Returns a cook as chartable series. Reads Home Assistant's own recorded history when it covers the cook, and falls back to Masterbuilt's cloud when it does not. Returned as a response; nothing is written to entity state.

device_id.name: Grill
device_id.description: Which grill to fetch a cook for.

session_id.name: Cook ID
session_id.description: A specific cook to fetch. Leave empty for the most recent one. Use 'List cooks' to find IDs.

max_points.name: Maximum points
max_points.description: Thin each series to at most this many points. A long cook can be several thousand samples.

source.name: Source
source.description: Auto reads locally when recorded history covers the cook and uses the cloud otherwise. Local never leaves Home Assistant. Cloud always fetches from Masterbuilt, at roughly 10-second resolution.

list_cooks.name: List cooks
list_cooks.description: Lists every cook Masterbuilt's cloud still holds, newest first, including cooks from before Home Assistant knew about the grill. Returns IDs and timings only, no sample data.

device_id.name: Grill
device_id.description: Which grill to list cooks for.
